title: 第224章 你该不会也被那贼秃给骗了吧第223章 你可愿拜我为师
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: “多谢闻师厚赐！”
沈修寒目光微动，接过依言扯看。
袋内空间方正，约莫三尺见方。
虽比他从萧焰遗骸上得来的储物袋小了足足四五倍，却也足以放下随身之物。
而袋中并非空空如也，还装着一枚有些眼熟的小瓷瓶。
沈修寒将其取出，隔着瓶壁，都能闻到一股清冽沁人的异香扑面而来，直透肺腑。
这小瓶、这香气…
他今日已经闻过一次，绝不会认错！
“这是…”
沈修寒抬眸望向闻青夜，脱口而出：
“百年地钟乳？”
闻青夜眉头微挑，眼中闪过讶异：
“你识得此物？”
沈修寒忙解释道：
“闻师有所不知，弟子今日在千池岛，遇到一位自称闻师旧友的大师，法号守冲。”
“那守冲大师便是用百年地钟乳，换了弟子一份功法誊本，弟子故而认得此香…”
他说着说着，声音不自觉低下去。
只因…
他发现闻青夜的脸色有些不对劲。
闻青夜面颊微抽，额角隐有青筋跳动，他深吸一口气，平稳了一整夜的语调，头一回出现了明显波动：
“那老秃驴…在何处？”
闻言，沈修寒再迟钝也明白过来了！
守冲老僧的那句‘与闻道友于云水湖心结识，甚是投契’，恐怕水分不小！
他不敢怠慢，连忙将在幽谷中遭遇守冲的经过，连同那座半塌破庙的具体方位，一五一十和盘托出。
“你且在此地莫要走动，本座去去就来！”
不待沈修寒答应，闻青夜已旱地拔葱般原地腾空而起，青衫被劲风吹得猎猎作响。
他周身沁出一层米粒大小的白色光点，密密麻麻，连绵成片，笼罩成一具由白光织就的罡罩。
闻青夜置身于那层白色罡罩之中，轰地一声，化作一道惊虹，朝千池岛破空而去。
速度之快，只在夜空中留下一道渐渐消散的白色尾痕！
“凭虚御风，凌空飞行…”
content_en:
"Thank you Master Wen for the generous gift!"
Shen Xiuhan's eyes moved slightly, and he took Yiyan and looked at it.
The space inside the bag is square, about three feet square.
Although it was four or five times smaller than the storage bag he got from Xiao Yan's remains, it was still enough to hold all his belongings.
The bag was not empty, there was also a small porcelain bottle that looked familiar.
Shen Xiuhan took it out and could smell a clear and refreshing fragrance through the bottle wall, blowing towards his face and penetrating his heart.
This vial, this scent...
He has already smelled it once today and will never admit it!
"This is..."
Shen Xiuhan raised his eyes to look at Wen Qingye and blurted out:
"A century-old stalactite?"
"Oh?"
Wen Qingye raised his eyebrows slightly, surprise flashed in his eyes:
"Do you recognize this thing?"
Shen Xiuhan hurriedly explained:
"Master Wen is unaware of something. Today on Qianchi Island, my disciple met a master who claimed to be an old friend of Master Wen. His dharma name is Shouchong."
"Master Shouchong used stalactite from a century-old land to exchange the disciple for a copy of the technique, so the disciple recognizes this incense..."
As he spoke, his voice lowered unconsciously.
Just because…
He noticed something was wrong with Wen Qingye's face.
Wen Qingye's cheeks twitched slightly, and there were hidden veins pulsing in the corner of his forehead. He took a deep breath and stabilized his tone all night, and for the first time there was an obvious fluctuation:
"Where is that old bald donkey...?"
"Uh..."
Hearing this, Shen Xiuhan realized it no matter how slow he was!
The old monk Shouchong's words, "I met fellow Taoist Wen in the middle of Yunshui Lake, it was a very good match", I'm afraid there is a lot of water in it!
He did not dare to neglect, and quickly told the story of his encounter with Shouchong in the valley, as well as the specific location of the half-collapsed temple.
"Don't move around here. I'll come as soon as I go!"
"Boom!"
Without waiting for Shen Xiuhan to agree, Wen Qingye jumped into the air like plucking onions from dry land, and his green shirt was blown by the strong wind.
A layer of white light spots the size of rice grains appeared all over his body, densely packed and continuous, covering him into a mask made of white light.
Wen Qingye was in the white shield, and with a bang, it turned into a startling rainbow and shot through the sky towards Qianchi Island.
The speed was so fast that it only left a white tail mark that gradually dissipated in the night sky!
"Use the illusion to control the wind and fly in the sky..."
title_en: Chapter 224: You must have been deceived by that thief, right? Chapter 223: Are you willing to worship me as your teacher?
